principle: indexes only for real reads; the history table carries its clustered PK + 3 small/partial indexes; FK columns run_id/artifact_id on versions are deliberately unindexed because parent deletes are blocked (no FK scans) and each index multiplies D1 rows written

indexes.name: idx_stat_artifacts_retention
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_artifacts_retention ON statistics_raw_artifacts(retention_class, expires_at) WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL;

indexes.name: idx_stat_ckpt_last_run
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_ckpt_last_run       ON statistics_checkpoints(last_run_id) WHERE last_run_id IS NOT NULL;

indexes.name: idx_stat_ckpt_lease
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_ckpt_lease          ON statistics_checkpoints(lease_expires_at) WHERE lease_run_id IS NOT NULL;

indexes.name: idx_stat_current_latest
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_current_latest      ON statistics_current_observations(series_id, period_start DESC);

indexes.name: idx_stat_events_state
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_events_state        ON statistics_release_events(eligibility_state, created_at);

indexes.name: idx_stat_events_url
indexes.query_served: dedupe against the existing news sub-feed by canonical URL
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_events_url          ON statistics_release_events(canonical_url_key);

indexes.name: idx_stat_geo_parent
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_geo_parent          ON statistics_geographies(parent_geography_id) WHERE parent_geography_id IS NOT NULL;

indexes.name: idx_stat_lineage_from
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_lineage_from        ON statistics_lineage_edges(from_ref);

indexes.name: idx_stat_lineage_to
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_lineage_to          ON statistics_lineage_edges(to_ref);

indexes.name: idx_stat_mappings_concept
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_mappings_concept    ON statistics_indicator_mappings(concept_code, state);

indexes.name: idx_stat_obsver_quality
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_obsver_quality      ON statistics_observation_versions(quality_state, created_at) WHERE quality_state <> 'VALID';

indexes.name: idx_stat_obsver_release
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_obsver_release      ON statistics_observation_versions(release_id, series_id);

indexes.name: idx_stat_obsver_revisions
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_obsver_revisions    ON statistics_observation_versions(created_at) WHERE revision_class NOT IN ('NEW_RELEASE','BACKFILL');

indexes.name: idx_stat_policy_planner
indexes.why: keeps the due-source scan off disabled rows
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_policy_planner      ON statistics_source_runtime_policy(runtime_state, next_due_at) WHERE runtime_state IN ('ACTIVE','ACTIVATION_GATED');

indexes.name: idx_stat_releases_ds_rank
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_releases_ds_rank    ON statistics_releases(dataset_id, release_rank DESC);

indexes.name: idx_stat_releases_feed
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_releases_feed       ON statistics_releases(published_at DESC) WHERE release_class = 'PRODUCTION';

indexes.name: idx_stat_runs_lease_expiry
indexes.query_served: lease expiry sweep of RUNNING runs
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_runs_lease_expiry   ON statistics_ingestion_runs(lease_expires_at) WHERE status = 'RUNNING';

indexes.name: idx_stat_runs_source_latest
indexes.write_cost: 1 per run insert (+ on planned_at change: never)
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_runs_source_latest  ON statistics_ingestion_runs(source_id, planned_at DESC);

indexes.name: idx_stat_sdim_canonical
indexes.query_served: extension dimension filter by canonical code
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_sdim_canonical      ON statistics_series_dimensions(dimension_key, canonical_value_code, series_id) WHERE canonical_value_code IS NOT NULL;

indexes.name: idx_stat_sdim_source
indexes.query_served: extension dimension filter by source code
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_sdim_source         ON statistics_series_dimensions(dimension_key, source_value_code, series_id);

indexes.name: idx_stat_series_geo_ind
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_series_geo_ind      ON statistics_series(geography_id, indicator_id);

indexes.name: idx_stat_series_ind_geo
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_series_ind_geo      ON statistics_series(indicator_id, geography_id, sex_code, age_group_code);

indexes.name: idx_stat_val_nonvalid
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_val_nonvalid        ON statistics_validation_events(status, created_at) WHERE status <> 'VALID';

indexes.name: idx_stat_val_release
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_val_release         ON statistics_validation_events(release_id, created_at) WHERE release_id IS NOT NULL;

indexes.name: idx_stat_val_run
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_val_run             ON statistics_validation_events(run_id) WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL;

indexes.name: idx_stat_val_version
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_val_version         ON statistics_validation_events(series_id, period_key, created_at) WHERE series_id IS NOT NULL;

indexes.name: uq_stat_runs_open_unit
indexes.query_served: at most one open run per bounded unit (idempotency/lease)
indexes.why: prevents double execution of the same unit
indexes.ddl: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_stat_runs_open_unit ON statistics_ingestion_runs(dataset_id, planned_unit_key) WHERE status IN ('PLANNED','RUNNING');
